# Voice fixtures

Generated speech, not recordings: 16 kHz 16-bit mono WAV, synthesised on
2026-10-17 with Piper 1.8.0 (`piper-tts`, run only as a tool outside this
repository; nothing of it is shipped) and the `en_US-ljspeech-medium` voice from
`rhasspy/piper-voices`, trained on the LJ Speech dataset (public domain), then
resampled from 22.05 kHz.

| File | Words |
| --- | --- |
| `fetch.wav` | bring me a tractor and forage wagon |
| `stop.wav` | stop |
| `status.wav` | what are you doing |
| `barn.wav` | take this back to the barn |
| `come.wav` | come here |
